title: PowerToys (Microsoft) — What it is
description: PowerToys is Microsoft's open-source collection of utilities for Windows power users: FancyZones tiles windows into custom layouts, PowerToys Run launches apps and files with Alt+Space, Color Picker grabs any screen color, Text Extractor OCRs text from images, and Keyboard Manager remaps keys. It is the fastest way to make Windows feel organized while multitasking across training terminals, notebooks and dashboards. It is made by Microsoft and runs on Windows 10/11.
